result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.heat_diffusion()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Diffuse heat from seed nodes through the network. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L18094-L18169){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.heat_diffusion( seeds, t=1.0, max_iter=50, attr_name=None, return_dict=False, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Places initial heat on seed nodes and lets it diffuse along edges using the heat equation on the graph Laplacian. The parameter `t` controls diffusion time: small values keep heat localized near seeds, large values spread it across the entire graph. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [seeds]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [dict[int, float]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Dictionary mapping seed node IDs to initial heat values. [t]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[1.0]{.fl}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Diffusion time. Larger values spread heat further. Must be positive. [max_iter]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[50]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Number of time steps for the iterative approximation. [attr_name]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Column name for the node DataFrame. Defaults to `"heat"`. [return_dict]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True`, returns the heat dictionary. Otherwise stores and returns self. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Union[dict[int, float], Graph]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Heat values for all nodes after diffusion. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#336faef9 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="Source") .add_node(label="Near") .add_node(label="Far") .add_edge("Source", "Near") .add_edge("Near", "Far") ) source_id = graph.get_id_from_label("Source") heat = graph.heat_diffusion(seeds={source_id: 10.0}, t=0.5, return_dict=True) {graph.get_label_from_id(nid): round(h, 4) for nid, h in heat.items()} ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` {'Source': 6.7218, 'Far': 0.6717, 'Near': 2.6064} ``` ::: :::
